notes.title: FSOG 3 Valentine's Update is here!
notes.notes:
Hey there, friends! 

Happy Valentine's Day to you all! Let the loved ones of yours know how much you love them tonight. And we've prepared decent discounts for you to help in this case! Grab Furry Shades Of Gay 3 with a nice discount of 30% now and pick up other games in the series with a discount of 50%!

Now, let's celebrate together with a new story, shall we?

Evan and Master are back! 

This Valentine’s Day is special for Evan. Him and his Master have been together for quite a while, and he’s excited to spend this special day together. He's a little nervous though? What are they to each other? Friends with benefits or something more? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/86db977214ff80abd5d094b18018b51fd29c23df.png

You can tell he's not the only one having a crisis there - his Master is clearly trying to tell Evan something important. Will they get distracted during their happy little dinner with all the gear in Master's house, or will their choice be a little more romantic this time? 

Find out in the story! There are more secrets to this couple than you think. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/d7f2fdb6f4f4bf06016e693127a9802a88d3c704.png

Wishlist our new game, if you're into girls as well:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221840/Sex_and_the_Furry_Titty_3_Come_Inside_Sweety/

And if you're into solving mysteries, boys, girls and other funky sexy creatures, we invite you into our Mansion of Memories:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575040/Mansion_of_Memories/

Join us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/furlough_games
Hang out with us on Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR

XO, 
Shane

notes.title: BIG XMAS UPDATE IS HERE!
notes.notes:
HO-HO-HO there!

The time has come, and now 5 new mini-stories with a nice celebratory vibe are ready to be open and played. By the way, to celebrate the release of Furry Shades Of Gay 2, the first game is at a 50% discount! 

6 CHRISTMAS STORIES

You've asked, we deliver! Well-known heroes are back to spend the holidays with you, accompanied by short stories full of pretty holiday artwork. Help Riley to gift his present to his beloved Maximus, decorate a tree with Alvin and Marcus, try convincing Azzie to make a show angel with Rowly... And much more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/5dedbdd93a63188f29077922dcdb7965fc7faec2.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/42f4ad1f1331cec7862f0e581a4140827fd2b6bc.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/6a36a8c3c2b363c16f47fb195a64b6609ce39b87.png

WHO'S THAT SANTA?

Jake is also celebrating, but in his own way, and seems like this Santa has very familiar... eyes. Cunningham went for a romantic move, and seems like the old flames are shining brighter than ever! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/3cb0b3356b68ccd450ef8462740014a848890953.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/fb4ad782a7cd68858b7ae8b37eef5a861837cfd3.png

Why is that a wolf and a rabbit can't get along? Who said that? Just put a Christmas bear in between and see how everything works out just right! Maybe this time it's Robbie who's caught Wolfgang, right?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/0cdc7bc828ba87a6d3b6b25bafad6df1c729f3a5.png

PUZZLE TIME! 

 Play your favorite match-3 game to open all the Christmas-themed bonus arts. Don't forget that you have to finish the major stories first. Have lots of fun with this fancy update! 

Okay, that's all for now, I hope you all will like the update, I'll come back with more news soon. 

Lovelovelove, 

Shane

notes.title: BIG CHRISTMAS UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hi there, friends! 

Shane is here to lighten up your day, because, right, winter season is almost here and it’s chilling our butts. 

So we’ve decided that it would be awesome to warm up with some short holiday stories. Yep, that’s right, you’ve heard it, old friends are coming back to celebrate Christmas with you this December! 

A big present!

As Christmas comes, some of our boys decide to party. Riley decides to surprise Maximus in a very special way, isn’t it cute? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/6a36a8c3c2b363c16f47fb195a64b6609ce39b87.png

Wolfgang and Robbie are ready to celebrate, too, and who knows which way their Christmas mini-gig can lead to…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/28572a9e5e073fc36bdfb404ed63dcc1776e32f0.png

Cameron and Cunningham are spending this Christmas together, too, look how romantic they seem!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/fb4ad782a7cd68858b7ae8b37eef5a861837cfd3.png

And seems like Alvin and Marcus are going to have a nice Christmas eve as well. What can be better than decorating a tree with your beloved one? Only decorating it with your attorney! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/b69e705656de97b69046c63438fe4fb17494ea35.png

Jake is going to have a good time, too. This Santa looks familiar, why would he miss this opportunity to wish for something special for him, right?

We’re excited, are you? Yes, awesome, we can’t wait either, but you know what? There’s more we want to tell you. 

As you might have noticed, we’re launching a new game this winter, and for us December is a big month, because you’re not only going to get free stories, but you’ll also get a release of Furry Shades Of Gay 2: A Shade Gayer! Isn’t it cool, right? 

Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist and subscribe to the community page, because there’s something else that we want to share with you, but what is it - you can find out in Furry Shades Of Gay 2 community page. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1724050/Furry_Shades_of_Gay_2_A_Shade_Gayer__Love_Stories_Episodes/
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/5c883749afe1270d2d8b9556519a847741db4878.gif

Well, that’s all for now, I hope you guys are having a great weekend. 

Follow our Twitter
Join our Discord server

All the love, 

Shane

notes.title: BONUS ART UPDATE AND ART PACK DLC
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

As the fall is here, it’s time to shake things up a little, right? That’s why we’re here to announce a bonus art update! We’re also pleased to say that DLC for Furry Shades of Gay is now up! Let’s dive deep into the news, shall we?
 

Bonus art update!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/c99a3e310b0dc3365069b73258134e69b919caf1.png
Nice and spicy, the new update brings you additional art which you can open completing the challenge after fully finishing the stories! More hot art of your favorite heroes from our beloved artists, isn’t it exciting?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/6f8d39bd4d97aeb1c8e24ae262d7c4493d78d1ff.png

After you clear any scenario and unlock story mode, two new plaques will appear (most are in the top left of the tree). Click on the left one, complete the challenge, and the bonus artwork will unlock!
 

DLC is up!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/07516ab20889ef1472cc51c71433e7ac33b11dd0.png
With this DLC bundle you’ll get access to high resolution artworks, sketches and more! Devil is in the details, and this one is pretty sexy and gay, so take a closer look to your favorite heroes! We’ve also included sketches, extra materials, and some pre-production style tryouts for your viewing pleasure.

After you purchase the DLC and the download finishes, right click on the game’s card or list entry, select Manage > Browse local files, and you’ll find all the artworks in the folder called “Art Pack”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/65f4093c73f637da5f9728b5d4865463bd48c6b1.png

And don’t forget, most of our profits go directly to the budgets for our future games! So if you want to see bigger and better stories, and more of them, please consider supporting us by purchasing this DLC!
 

Little reminder
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/9ca20486099e431467e4d1cf8c8f1a3fc187ef1e.png
Thank you for your endless support, it helps us bring you more games with fantastic art, and improve the overall experience!

Don’t forget to add Furry Shades of Gay 2: a Shade Gayer to your wishlist, it’s going to be an awesome adventure, we promise!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1724050/Furry_Shades_of_Gay_2_A_Shade_Gayer__Love_Stories_Episodes/

The store page for Sex and the Furry Titty 2 is also up, and the game itself is scheduled for Spring 2022. If you are interested in ladies as well, don’t hesitate to wishlist and follow!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1750200/Sex_and_the_Furry_Titty_2_Sins_of_the_City__Love_Stories_Episodes/

Follow our Twitter for more exclusive content and fun!
https://twitter.com/furlough_games

Join our Discord server to make new friends, share your experience and fan arts with us!
https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR

Hugs and kisses,
Furlough Games Team

notes.title: First major update, future plans, and the future of Furlough Games
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

Our first semi-major update to the game went live. It brings a new pattern match and a new bonus item. It goes boom!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/caa1ac62291aaef3285fc5008d8a6b462f17dbf9.png

Just match items in T- or L-pattern, and you'll get a "bomb" bonus item. Match this one, and it will obliterate all the items around it.

Almost all the challenge levels were also rebalanced, it should be much easier to clear out the stories now. 

We’ve also had a couple of awesome people reach out to us about the help with the localization, and we’ve already included some improved scripts and UI localization changes.

There are also a number of bugfixes related to the challenge level freezes and script mix-ups.

Upcoming goodies
Right now we’re working on implementing the “story mode” and achievements. We also got green light on adding trading cards and community items to the game, so expect the first set soon!

And we are working on a FREE bonus story, coming this February. Don’t want to spoil it too much, so will only share a couple of storyboard clippings for now:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/bb948da73c33fd63b67c291e036dc206fec37050.png
We hope you’ll like it!


Future of Furlough Games
And now to some less cheery news. First of all, we are incredibly grateful for all the great reception the game got, and we are super happy that so many people found it fun.

Alas, our sales still fell short of the amount that was required to keep the whole studio working full-time. So, keeping true to our name, we are downsizing, at least for a time. Our lead developer is going to return to the contract work, and the rest of us will pick up some side gigs as well.

That said, we have no plans to give up just yet. The artists all got paid in full, so we are starting work on another game. It won’t be a sequel, more of a sidequel. Same genre, but targeting a different niche, one with a more mass-market appeal. If we can make this work, we will try to alternate between niches, and if at all possible, explore even more underserved ones in the future. 

Official announcement will come soon enough, once we have some art to share, so stay tuned!

With love,
- Felix Vine
